segments.text: What if Levi turned cleaning day into a survival drill? The furious man has concerns.
segments.label: THE MOP IS NOT OPTIONAL

segments.text: Eren complains about wasted time. Bro wants heroic action but cannot locate the bucket beside him.
segments.label: EREN HAS OPINIONS

segments.text: Levi checks a dirty strap and finds wear. This isn't about shiny furniture.
segments.label: THE INSPECTION

segments.text: A frayed line doesn't care about freedom speeches. Main character energy makes terrible replacement safety equipment.
segments.label: GEAR DOES NOT CARE ABOUT AURA

segments.text: Armin understands. Cleaning makes them inspect parts and explain their findings.
segments.label: ARMIN CONNECTS THE DOTS

segments.text: Levi moves the supplies. Find replacements. Communicate. Welcome to logistics with aggressive eye contact.
segments.label: THE SECOND TEST

segments.text: Eren volunteers to carry everything. My guy, one mistake becomes the whole squad's problem.
segments.label: THE LOUD SOLUTION FAILS

segments.text: They distribute essentials and check each other's gear. Not flashy. Neither is surviving because somebody checked a buckle.
segments.label: SPLIT THE LOAD

segments.text: This doesn't guarantee safety. It removes avoidable failures. Those are different claims, and Armin knows it.
segments.label: NO MAGIC INVINCIBILITY

segments.text: The lesson is attention. Find the boring detail before a crisis makes it exciting.
segments.label: THE ACTUAL LESSON

segments.text: Eren finally cleans properly. The bucket receives more character development than half the speeches in that room.
segments.label: THE BUCKET GETS ITS ARC

segments.text: Levi spots one speck. Everybody freezes. They survived the drill. Unfortunately, their supervisor has just discovered overtime.
segments.label: INSPECTION CONTINUES
